Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.SCOPE OF SUPPLY:-ISI marked 4c x 70 sq.mm XLPE Aluminium armo ured cable.Preferred makes: Havells, Polycab, Finolex, RR and KEI or E quivalent. 2.OEM Authorization: The bidder must be an Original Equipment Manuf acturer (OEM) or an authorized OEM partner/dealer. In case the bidder is not the OEM, a valid bid specific authorization certificate from the OE M must be uploaded along with the bid. 3.Past Performance:Bidders who have successfully supplied the same item/similar item ( similar items means 4 Core cable of different diame ter like 25 sq.mm, 35 s q.mm etc) to any Indian Railways establishmen ts/PSUs/govtdept for minimum 20% of the tendered quantity (for same items) and 20% of current tender estimate value (for similar items) in a single order during the last three years (Backward from bid opening date) will only be considered for placement of order (as there is no pro vision of giving developmental order in GeM) . Bidders to submit proof of supply like CRN, R-note, or Completion certificates along with offer, Failing which offer shall not be considered.

4.EMD Exemption: EMD exemption is allowed strictly in accordance wit h GeM GTC and Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012 (as am ended) and Railway Board guidelines. No other category is eligible unl ess specifically mentioned. The firm need to attach UDAYAM Certificat e. 5.WARRANTY CLAUSE: Warranty of 30 Months from the date of supply i s required the seller, the firm has to accept the same at the time of bid duly giving a declaration of the same or else offer may be rejected.War ranty certificate to be submitted at the time of supply. 6.Marking & Identification The cable shall have embossing for Name of Manufacturer and Product detail (Voltage Grade/Core/Size/Type) and P rinting and on drum for Year of manufacturing , IS Standard with ISI ma rk , Batch/Lot No.,CM/L No. and Provision of sequential length marking to be done by printing. 7.ESSENTIAL DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED BY THE BIDDER: (i) The f irm has to provide CR Test report along with supply, to be attached alo ng with offer or else offer may be rejected. (ii) The manufacturer shall have an IN-HOUSE NABL-APPROVED LABORATORY for routine and type testing o f cables.NABL APPROVED LAB CERTIFICATE should be submitt ed at the time of bidding or else offer shall b e rejected. (iii) Valid BIS C ertificate and License number to be attached along with offer or else o ffer shall be rejected. (iv) Routine Test Certificate for supplied lot Manu facturer Test Certificate (MTC) to be attached. 8.Inspection & Testing: Supply shall be subject to Pre-Dispatch Inspecti on (PDI) by nominated third-party inspection agency. - Buyer reserves the right to draw samples at any stag e and get them tested at CPRI / ERDA / NABL Lab. - In case of test failure, the entire lot shall be rejecte d and testing charges shall be borne by the supplier. 9.Packing & Dispatch: Cables shall be supplied in factory-sealed drums , properly packed , with drum number and batch number traceable to t he test certificates. Loose or repacked material shall not be accepted. 10.Rejection & Penalty: In case of supply of substandard, counterfeit, o r non-conforming material, the same shall be rejected at supplier’s risk and cost, and suitable action including risk purchase and reporting on GeM portal shall be initiated. 11.Special instruction: (i) Manufacturer's Test Certificate Should be sub mitted by the Firm along with the supply. (ii) The tenderer shall careful ly study the item description, specification, drawing, and all tender con

ditions before quoting. Submission of offer shall be deemed as confirm ation that the firm has fully understood and accepted all requirements. (iii) Any ambiguity or clarification regarding specification/drawing shall be sought before closing of tender. No post-tender or post-placement o f order clarification will be entertained and supply shall be strictly as p er purchase order, failing which action including cancellation at firm’s r isk & cost may be taken. (iv) Bidders are required to upload all relevan t documents in support of their offer at the time of submission of bid. N o new document(s) shall be accepted after opening of tender. All required documents in support of eligibility, technical compliance, past performance, financial capability, or any other tender condition must b e submitted along with the bid Only clarifications, if sought by purchas er, shall be limited to the documents already submitted and shall not i nvolve submission of any fresh document having a bearing on eligibilit y or evaluation. In case of non-submission of required documents with the bid, the offer is liable to be r ejected. (v) The quantity to be ordere d will be decided duly considering factors such as past performance, d elivery requirements, quantity under procurement, nature of items etc. , CONTACT DETAILS : - 8056162314 .
